the change adds one ruff finding the tree did not have: S112 try-except-continue on _move_sprint_versions' per-sprint read. Ruff on mcp_edit_plan.py reports 7 findings at ba742341e8 and 8 at 88e7bee930, so the manifest's 'ruff delta added no findings' and the done_when's clean-changed-paths requirement both fail on a one-line fix.

the except json.JSONDecodeError branch is redundant: the (KeyError, ValueError) clause immediately beneath it raises the identical ProjectStateError and already covers JSONDecodeError, since JSONDecodeError subclasses ValueError, so the new clause only reads as if it handled something the next one does not.
